name: TeamStarWolf - The Year 2023 in Intrusions
description: Curated case-study layer, not an official MITRE mapping. ATT&CK Enterprise techniques that the verified 2023 record supports: the CISA and partner advisories of the year (AA23-025A, AA23-061A, AA23-075A, AA23-129A, AA23-136A, AA23-144A, AA23-158A, AA23-165A, AA23-201A, AA23-213A, AA23-270A, AA23-284A, AA23-320A, AA23-325A, AA23-335A, AA23-341A, AA23-347A, AA23-352A, AA23-353A and others), Microsoft, Mandiant, Google and the victims' own reports, and the ATT&CK objects the study binds. Revoked ids printed by the advisories are shown under their v20.0 successors from data/attack/superseded_by.jsonl. Each comment names source numbers from case-studies/CHRONICLE_2023.md. Scores: 100 an opened source or ATT&CK object prints the id, 70 the source describes the behavior and the study assigns the id, 40 Inferred (the Storm-0558 rows, whose sources list no ids).
